Title: Gaia DR3 slow-Vgrf catalogue, Tier A+B+C orbit summaries and actions
Authors: Humble R.
Table: Tier A+B+C point-estimate orbit summaries, actions, and chemistry. Tier membership uses the population-prior corrected score
================================================================================
Byte-by-byte Description of file: table.dat
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Bytes Format Units  Label     Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1- 19  I19        ---    source_id               Gaia DR3 source identifier
     21  A1         ---    tier                    Adopted membership tier after
                                              the population-prior correction
                                              (A/B/C)
     23  A1         ---    tier_forward            Membership tier from the
                                              uncorrected forward score (A/B/C)
 25- 30  F6.4       ---    P_vgrf_below_25         [0.58/1.0] Forward Monte
                                              Carlo probability that Vgrf < 25
                                              km/s
 32- 52  F21.19     kpc    static_R_peri_kpc       [0.0/0.51] Pericentre radius
                                              in the static Hunter+2024
                                              potential
 54- 72  F19.16     kpc    static_R_apo_kpc        [3.82/14.73] Apocentre radius
                                              in the static potential
 74- 93  F20.18     kpc    static_z_max_kpc        [0.01/7.71] Maximum absolute
                                              height in the static potential
 95-112  F18.16     ---    static_ecc              [0.9/1.0] Orbital
                                              eccentricity (R_apo-
                                              R_peri)/(R_apo+R_peri), static
                                              potential
114-134  F21.16 km.kpc.s-1 static_Lz_kpc_kms       [-223.86/239.65] Mean
                                              z-angular momentum L_z in the
                                              static potential
136-154  F19.14 km.kpc.s-1 J_R                     [285.69/1131.53] Radial
                                              action (single-evaluation Staeckel
                                              fudge); caveated, see
                                              action_reliability_flag
156-178  F23.19 km.kpc.s-1 J_z                     [0.0/292.35] Vertical action
                                              (single-evaluation Staeckel
                                              fudge); least reliable for these
                                              orbits
180-200  F21.16 km.kpc.s-1 J_phi                   [-223.86/239.65] Azimuthal
                                              action (single-evaluation Staeckel
                                              fudge)
202-220  F19.14 km.kpc.s-1 J_R_timeavg             [291.27/1107.03] Convergent
                                              radial action (orbit-time-averaged
                                              over 4 Gyr)
222-242  F21.17 km.kpc.s-1 J_z_timeavg             [0.0/276.64] Convergent
                                              vertical action (orbit-time-
                                              averaged over 4 Gyr)
244-264  F21.16 km.kpc.s-1 J_phi_timeavg           [-223.86/239.65] Convergent
                                              azimuthal action (orbit-time-
                                              averaged over 4 Gyr)
266-286  F21.19     ---    action_max_fracdiff     [0.0/1.6] Max |single-eval -
                                              time-averaged|/max(|time-avg|,1)
                                              over J_R,J_z,J_phi
288-311  A24        ---    action_reliability_flag Per-star action reliability
                                              (sampled_ok/caution/poor)
313-319  F7.4       ---    mh_gspphot              [-3.66/0.44]? Gaia GSP-Phot
                                              photometric metallicity [M/H] in
                                              dex (blank if none)
321-329  F9.6       ---    feh_spec                ? Spectroscopic [Fe/H] in dex
                                              from APOGEE DR17/GALAH DR3 (blank
                                              if no match)
331-338  F8.6       ---    alpha_spec              ? Spectroscopic alpha proxy
                                              in dex (blank if none)
340-355  A16        ---    chem_survey             ? Spectroscopic source
                                              (APOGEE/GALAH; blank if none)
357-372  A16        ---    chem_population         ? Chemodynamic class
                                              (Splash/GSE/Aurora/disk/unclassifi
                                              ed; blank if none)
374-378  A5         ---    nss_two_body            Gaia DR3 nss_two_body_orbit
                                              non-single-star flag (True/False)
380-395  A16        ---    nss_solution_type       ? Gaia DR3 NSS solution type
                                              (SB1/Orbital/AstroSpectroSB1;
                                              blank if not matched)
